prompts.label: Twilight baseball scene â friends in the woods at night
prompts.text: Use the photo: keep every person in it recognisable, same faces, hair, skin tones and builds; if the photo shows only one person, two friends join them. Woods at night lit only by a phone flash and one path lamp, dead leaves on the ground, vertical 9:16, realistic handheld phone video. (1) The main character from the photo stands on the leaves in a cap, winds up, kicks one leg high and pitches into the dark. (2) Quick cuts: a friend sprints past the camera, another leaps over a low bush, the main character dashes along the path with hair flying. (3) Last shot: the main character runs straight at a thick tree trunk and scrambles up it in two big moves, then looks down at the camera from a branch. Audio: rustling leaves, fast footsteps, a distant thunder roll and a driving rock beat, no vocals, no song. No text, no captions, no logos or writing on any clothes, no watermark.

prompts.label: Twilight baseball scene â the hotel lobby pitch
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person recognisable from the first frame to the last: same face, hair, skin tone and build. An empty hotel lobby at night with a patterned carpet and a wall of glass showing lit-up city towers, vertical 9:16, realistic phone video filmed from a few metres away. They wear a plain white button-up baseball jersey, black leggings, striped knee socks and a plain dark cap, with nothing printed on any of it. (1) They come to a slow set position, glove hand at the chest, staring down an invisible batter. (2) They kick one leg straight up as high as it will go and hold it for a beat. (3) They step through and fire an imaginary pitch with the whole body, the follow-through spinning them half round. (4) Last shot: they look back at the camera over the shoulder, deadly serious. Audio: a crack of thunder on the pitch, the hum of the empty lobby and a driving rock beat, no vocals, no song. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
